llms:
Formula Per edge sample at fraction t along u->v and per pixel within the buffer radius: cost = abs(sourceCost + t*weight + walk*pixelDistance); each pixel keeps the minimum cost over all samples (min mode; atomic minimum on order-preserving f32 bits, so the result does not depend on thread order). Samples are linear along straight segments between node positions, so this is a sampled raster, not an exact polygonal travel-time boundary; pixels no sample reaches stay unreached.
